syndrome.pharyngitis.name: Acute pharyngitis (tonsillopharyngitis)
question.phar_complication.label: Peritonsillar abscess, deep neck infection or severe systemic illness
question.phar_fever.label: Fever (over 38 °C)
question.phar_exudate.label: Swollen or exudative tonsils
question.phar_nodes.label: Tender anterior cervical nodes
question.phar_no_cough.label: No cough or coryza
question.phar_rapid.label: Seen within 3 days of onset
question.phar_inflamed.label: Severely inflamed tonsils
question.phar_age.label: Age
question.gas_test.label: Rapid antigen test or throat culture
pharyngitis.idsa.refer: Suppurative complication or severe systemic illness: refer to hospital.
pharyngitis.idsa.viral: Cough or coryza suggests viral pharyngitis: no test and no antibiotic.
pharyngitis.idsa.negative: In adults a negative rapid test is enough; no culture and no antibiotic.
pharyngitis.idsa.treat: Confirmed GAS pharyngitis: penicillin or amoxicillin for 10 days; with allergy a first-generation cephalosporin if not anaphylactic, otherwise clindamycin or a macrolide.
pharyngitis.idsa.test_first: Test first with a rapid antigen test or throat culture; antibiotic only if positive.
pharyngitis.tr.refer: Peritonsillar abscess and deep neck infection need surgery: refer.
pharyngitis.tr.low: McIsaac score 0-1: viral cause; no test, no antibiotic, symptomatic care.
pharyngitis.tr.negative: Score 4 or more but a negative test: no antibiotic.
pharyngitis.tr.treat_empiric: McIsaac score 4 or more: take a culture and treat empirically; penicillin V for 10 days. Clindamycin in type I allergy.
pharyngitis.tr.treat_positive: Positive test: penicillin V for 10 days. Clindamycin in type I allergy; keep macrolide resistance in mind.
pharyngitis.tr.test: McIsaac score 2-3: rapid antigen test and/or culture; antibiotic only if positive.
pharyngitis.nice.refer: Severe systemic infection or suppurative complication: refer to hospital.
pharyngitis.nice.treat: FeverPAIN 4-5 or Centor 3-4: immediate or back-up phenoxymethylpenicillin for 5-10 days; clarithromycin with allergy, erythromycin in pregnancy, 5 days.
pharyngitis.nice.backup: FeverPAIN 2-3: no antibiotic, or a back-up prescription to use if worse in 3-5 days.
pharyngitis.nice.low: FeverPAIN 0-1 or Centor 0-2: no antibiotic; pain relief and self-care.
